integrity: The first Rayleigh residual is evaluated exactly. The two-dimensional Krylov subspace is represented by a nonsingular limiting basis, and the limiting symmetric definite generalized Ritz problem is solved exactly. Simplicity of the limiting top Ritz value yields continuity of its Ritz vector and residual. Variational strict improvement and dimension-three minimality are proved separately. The packaged checker replays exact identities and a high-precision finite witness.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic analysis of the largest Ritz pair from Krylov dimensions one and two on a structured 3x3 SPD family with condition number two. The residual amplification is relative to a vanishing first residual; no claim is made about typical Lanczos behavior, finite precision, restarted methods, or absolute unboundedness of the second residual.
title: A better largest Lanczos Ritz value can have an arbitrarily worse residual at condition number two
